rows.note: Use 發生 as the all-purpose choice for something occurring or taking place.

example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 dim2 joeng2 faat3 sang1 gaa3

rows.note: Use 咁啱 when something happens by chance or when someone happens to do something.

example.english: I happen to be free today, so let’s have lunch together.
example.traditional: 咁啱我今日得閒，咪一齊食飯囉。
example.jyutping: gam3 ngaam1 ngo5 gam1 jat6 dak1 haan4 mai5 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 lo1
